English Wizard.question: ১) He said to me, “Will you obey my order now?” (Make it indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He said to me that I would obey his order now.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He asked me that I would obey his order now.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He inquired of me if I would obey his order then.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He asked me that I would obey his order then.
English Wizard.exp:
১-৯ সবগুলো প্রশ্নের জন্য Basic তথ্য: 
Direct Narration থেকে Indirect Narration এ রূপান্তর করতে হলে basic ৬টা কাজ (কাজ থাকা সাপেক্ষে) করতে হয়।
1.    Reported Speech এর Sentence এর প্রকার অনুযায়ী Reporting Verb পরিবর্তন করতে হবে। যেমন- say => tell/ ask/ order/ pray/ exclaim with joy ইত্যাদি। 
2.    Inverted Comma উঠিয়ে Reported Speech এর Sentence এর প্রকার অনুযায়ী that/ if/ to যোগ করতে হবে। 
3.    বক্তা ও শ্রোতা অনুযায়ী Reported Speech এর Subject ও Object পরিবর্তন করতে হবে। 
4.    Reporting Verb, Past Tense হলে, Reported Speech এর Tense পরিবর্তন করতে হবে। 
5.    Reporting Verb, Past Tense হলে, Reported Speech এ নিকটবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দকে দূরবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দে পরিণত করতে হবে। যেমন- here => there, now => then ইত্যাদি।
6.    সব ধরনের Sentence কে Assertive Sentence বানাতে হবে। 
--------------------------
১নং প্রশ্নের জন্য: 
i)    Interrogative Sentence হওয়ায় Reporting Verb -Say এর পরিবের্তে inquire (of + object) (জানতে চওয়া)/ ask (জিজ্ঞাসা করা) ব্যবহার করতে হবে। 
ii)    Yes/No Question হওয়ায় Reported speech শুরু করার পূর্বে If/whether (কি না) ব্যবহার করতে হবে।  
iii)    বক্তা ও শ্রোতা অনুযায়ী Reported Speech এর Subject ও Object পরিবর্তন করতে হবে। (you => I, my => his)
iv)    Reporting Verb (say) Past Tense হওয়ায় Reported Speech (Inverted Comma এর ভেতরের অংশ) নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Past Form এ রূপান্তর করতে হবে। (will => would)
v)    Reporting Verb, Past Tense হওয়ায় Reported Speech এ নিকটবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দকে দূরবর্তী নির্দেশনাসূচক শব্দে পরিণত করতে হবে। (now => then)
vi)    Sentence কে Assertive Sentence বানাতে হবে। অর্থাৎ এখানে Auxiliary Verb – would- Subject এর পরে বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ২) He told me that he had not gone there the previous day. (Make it Direct)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He said to me, “I have not gone there the previous day.”
English Wizard.option2: খ) He said to me, “I did not go there yesterday.”
English Wizard.option3: গ) He said to me, “I have not come here the previous day”.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He said to me, “I had not gone there yesterday.”
English Wizard.exp:
Indirect Narration এ Past Perfect থাকলে তিনটি Tense হওয়ার সম্ভাবনা আছে (যা নির্ধারিত হবে Adverb of Time, Conjunction ইত্যাদির উপর ভিত্তি করে)। যথা- 
1.    Present Perfect 
2.    Past Indefinite 
3.    Past Perfect
যেহেতু এখানে the previous day উল্লেখ করা আছে, তাই এটা Past Indefinite Tense হওয়াই বাঞ্ছনীয়। আর the previous day এর পরিবর্তে yesterday ব্যবহৃত হবে।

English Wizard.question: ৩) I said to Ben, “May you keep well”. (Make it indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I prayed to Ben that he might keep well.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I wished Ben that he must keep well.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I wished Ben that he may keep well.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I wished Ben that he might keep well.
English Wizard.exp:
Optative Sentence এ say => pray/wish ব্যবহৃত হয়।
wish + object = object এর জন্য শুভ কামনা করা। 
pray = প্রার্থনা করা।
কিন্তু pray to + object = Object এর কাছে প্রার্থনা করা।

English Wizard.question: ৪) I say to you, “Bashar can easily manage this though he seems foolish”. (Make it indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I say to you that Bashar can easily manage this though he seems foolish.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I tell you that Bashar could easily manage that though he seemed foolish.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I tell to you that Bashar can easily manage this though he seems foolish.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I wish you that Bashar can easily manage this though he seems foolish.
English Wizard.exp:
Assertive Sentence এ Say এর পরে (to + Object) থাকলে (say to + Object) / (tell + object) দুইটাই বসানো শুদ্ধ।
Reporting Verb (say) Present Tense হলে শুধু Subject – Object পরিবর্তন হয়। এখানে Subject Noun থাকায় সেটাও পরিবর্তন হবে না।
কেবল Inverted Comma উঠে যাবে আর মাঝখানে that বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ৫) He requested me to clarify the matter. (Make it direct)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He said to me, “You will clarify the matter”.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He said to me, “Please, clarify the matter”.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He said to me, “You clarify the matter”.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He said to me, “Will you clarify the matter?”
English Wizard.exp: Indirect Narration এ request থাকলে please যোগ হতে পারে এবং বাক্যটা Imperative হবে।

English Wizard.question: ৬) Redwan said to Joynal, “Let’s rescue the wounded person”. (Make it indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Redwan proposed to Joynal that he should rescue the wounded person.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Redwan proposed to Joynal that we should rescue the wounded person.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Redwan proposed to Joynal that they should rescue the wounded person.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Redwan requested Joynal to rescue the wounded person.
English Wizard.exp:
Let’s দিয়ে বক্তা এবং শ্রোতা উভয়কে বুঝাচ্ছে। 
Redwan + Joynal = they 
অতএব, সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ৭) Pitter said to me, “What is your aim in life?” (Make it indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Pitter asked me what was my aim in life.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Pitter asked me what is my aim in life.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Pitter asked me what my aim in life is.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Pitter asked me what my aim in life was.
English Wizard.exp:
Interrogative Sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে Reporting Verb -Say এর পরিবের্তে inquire (of + object) (জানতে চওয়া)/ ask (জিজ্ঞাসা করা) ব্যবহার করতে হবে। 
Indirect এ সব ধরনের বাক্যকে Assertive Form এ লিখতে হবে, তাই Auxiliary Verb – Subject এর পর বসবে। 
আর Reporting Verb – Past Tense হওয়ায় Reported Speech এ is এর জায়গায় was হবে।

English Wizard.question: ৮) He said to her, “Good bye”. (Make it indirect)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He told her good bye.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He called her good bye.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He bade her good bye.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He byed her good.
English Wizard.exp: বিদায় জানানোর জন্য bid-bade-bidden +good bye/ farewell ব্যবহৃত হয়।

English Wizard.question: ৯) He asked me if I had ever heard the name of Halaku Khan. (Make it direct)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He said to me, “If you have ever heard the name of Halaku Khan?”
English Wizard.option2: খ) He said to me, “Did you ever hear the name of Halaku Khan?”
English Wizard.option3: গ) He said to me, “Have you ever heard the name of Halaku Khan?”
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He said to me, “Do you ever hear the name of Halaku Khan?”
English Wizard.exp:
Indirect Narration এ Past Perfect থাকলে তিনটি Tense হওয়ার সম্ভাবনা আছে।
যথা- 
1.    Present Perfect 
2.    Past Indefinite 
3.    Past Perfect
যেহেতু এখানে ever (কখনো) উল্লেখ করা আছে, তাই এটা Present Perfect Tense হওয়াই বাঞ্ছনীয়।

English Wizard.question: ১০) ‘Abridgement’ means-
English Wizard.option1: ক) a shortened form of a book
English Wizard.option2: খ) connecting two banks of a river
English Wizard.option3: গ) marital contract
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) final statement
English Wizard.exp: Abridgement = বইয়ের সংক্ষিপ্ত রূপ = a shortened form of a book

English Wizard.question: ১১) ‘Alignment’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) making illumined
English Wizard.option2: খ) arrangement in a straight line
English Wizard.option3: গ) making valid
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) unity
English Wizard.exp: Alignment = সরলরেখায় বিন্যাস = arrangement in a straight line

English Wizard.question: ১২) ‘Dichotomy’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) foreign interference
English Wizard.option2: খ) division into two parts
English Wizard.option3: গ) study of human behaviour
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) disorder
English Wizard.exp: Dichotomy = দ্বিবিভাজন = division into two parts

English Wizard.question: ১৩) ‘Psychologist’ refers to –
English Wizard.option1: ক) study of human mind
English Wizard.option2: খ) a doctor who treats mental illness
English Wizard.option3: গ) one who studies human mind
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) one who can hypnotize others
English Wizard.exp:
Psychologist = মনোবিজ্ঞানী, মনোবিদ = one who studies human mind
Psychology = মনোবিজ্ঞান = study of human mind
Psychiatrist = মনোরোগ বিশেষজ্ঞ =  a doctor who treats mental illness
Hypnotist = সম্মোহনবিজ্ঞানী = one who can hypnotize others

English Wizard.question: ১৪) How interesting the story was! (Make it assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) It was an interesting story.
English Wizard.option2: খ) It was a very interesting story.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The story was very interesting.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The story was enough interesting.
English Wizard.exp:
এখানে Subject হচ্ছে the bird.
How এর পরিবর্তে Assertive Sentence এ সাধারণত very ব্যবহৃত হয়। 
Enough বসালে বাক্যের ভাবার্থ ঠিক থাকবে না। তাছাড়া Adjective এর আগে enough বসে না, পরে বসে। Noun এর আগে enough বসতে পারে।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) They should respect their teachers. (Make it imperative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Respect their teachers.
English Wizard.option2: খ) They respect their teachers.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let them respect their teachers.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let’s respect their teachers.
English Wizard.exp: You ছাড়া অন্য Subject থাকলে Imperative Sentence এর শুরুতে Let ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং Subject এর Objective Form বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৬) If I had been a rich man! (Make it Assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I wish I had been a rich man.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I wished I had been a rich man.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I wish I were a rich man.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I wish If I were a rich man.
English Wizard.exp:
If + Past Indefinite দিয়ে বর্তমানের কোনো কিছুর জন্য আকাঙ্ক্ষা করা হয়। আর If + Past Perfect দিয়ে অতীতের কোনো কিছুর জন্য আক্ষেপ করা হয়। অর্থাৎ প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির অর্থ – ইস আমি যদি (অতীতে) একজন ধনী লোক হতাম!
কিন্তু Exclamatory যে Tense ই হোক না কেন Assertive করতে হলে, If বাদ গিয়ে I wish – Present Tense এ বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৭) I made a mistake. (Make it interrogative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Do I made a mistake?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Don’t I make a mistake?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Did I make a mistake?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Didn’t I make a mistake?
English Wizard.exp:
Assertive কে Interrogative এ Transform করতে হলে Negative Interrogative এ পরিণত করতে হয়।
এর পাশাপাশি Past Indefinite Tense হওয়ায় Didn’t যোগ হবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৮) Where can he see me? (Make it assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He can never see me.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He can see me nowhere.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He cannot see me somewhere.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He cannot see me wherever.
English Wizard.exp:
Where যুক্ত Interrogative কে Assertive করতে হলে nowhere (কোথাও না) বসবে। 
Somewhere = কোনো একটা জায়গায়
Wherever = যেখানেই হোক না কেন। এটা সাধারণত Negative বাক্যের মধ্যে বসে না।

English Wizard.question: ১৯) Everybody accepted it. (Make it Interrogative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Who not accepted it?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Who have not accepted it?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Who did not accept it?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Does everybody accept it?
English Wizard.exp:
Everybody থাকলে Who + not বসে। 
বাক্যটি Past Indefinite Tense হওয়ায় Did not যোগ হবে।

English Wizard.question: ২০) Never yield to corruption. (Make it Assertive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) You will never yield to corruption.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We should never yield to corruption.
English Wizard.option3: গ) You should never yield to corruption.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) You never should yield to corruption.
English Wizard.exp: (No explanation added)

English Wizard.question: ২১) It is a matter of sorrow that you have lost your brother. (Make it exclamatory)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Fie! You have lost your brother.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Alas! You have lost your brother.
English Wizard.option3: গ) How have you lost your brother!
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Have you lost your brother!
English Wizard.exp:
Imperative কে Assertive করতে হলে Subject না থাকলে Subject হিসেবে you বসবে। এর পর Should বসবে।
তাই সঠিক উত্তর (গ)। 
ঘ- Never, Auxiliary Verb এর আগে বসে না।

English Wizard.question: ২২) ‘Misogynist’ means-
English Wizard.option1: ক) One who hates marriage
English Wizard.option2: খ) One who hates women
English Wizard.option3: গ) One who walks at night
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) One who hates mankind
English Wizard.exp:
- Misogynist = নারীবিদ্বেষী = One who hates women,
- Misogamist = বিবাহবিদ্বেষী = One who hates marriage,
- Noctambulist = যে রাতের বেলা হাঁটে = One who walks at night,
- Misanthropist = নরবিদ্বেষী = One who hates mankind

English Wizard.question: ২৩) ‘Carnivorous’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) Living on fruits
English Wizard.option2: খ) Living on grass
English Wizard.option3: গ) Living on fish
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Living on flesh
English Wizard.exp:
- Carnivorous = মাংসাশী = Living on flesh,
- Frugivorous = ফলভোজী = Living on fruits,
- Herbivorous = তৃণভোজী = Living on grass,
- Piscivorous = মৎস্যভোজী = Living on fish

English Wizard.question: ২৪) A place where birds or animals can live protected from hunters is called -
English Wizard.option1: ক) Kennel
English Wizard.option2: খ) Perch
English Wizard.option3: গ) Sanctuary
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Stable
English Wizard.exp:
- Sanctuary = অভয়ারণ্য = A place where birds or animals can live protected from hunters,
- Kennel = কুকুরশালা,
- Perch = পাখির বসার জায়গা,
- Stable = ঘোড়াশাল

English Wizard.question: ২৫) One who carves on stones is called –
English Wizard.option1: ক) pilgrim
English Wizard.option2: খ) polyglot
English Wizard.option3: গ) sculptor
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) usurer
English Wizard.exp:
- Sculptor = ভাস্কর = One who carves on stones,
- Pilgrim = তীর্থযাত্রী,
- Polyglot = বহুভাষাভাষী,
- Usurer = সুদখোর
